ruleDefinitions.name: DriverQuery.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "driverquery" utility. Which can be used to perform reconnaissance on installed drivers

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("driverquery\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "drvqry\.exe") AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))))
